label: PROVOCATION
text: Jerawat udah hilang, bekasnya masih bandel?
start_state: Creator faces camera directly, skin visible with faint acne marks under warm natural light, no product in frame
action: Creator stares into lens with eyebrow raised, then taps cheek lightly, then shakes head slowly
audio_note: quiet room tone, no music yet
why: setup — provocative question mirrors viewer's exact pain point to stop the scroll

label: DEMO
text: Ini serum yang aku pakai tiap malam, teksturnya ringan banget di kulit.
start_state: Creator holds small serum bottle loosely at chest height, dropper tip visible but label partially obscured by thumb
framing: medium selfie, face and hands in frame
camera: slow push in toward product in hand
action: Creator lifts bottle into frame, then applies one drop onto fingertip, then presses finger gently onto cheek
audio_note: soft upbeat lo-fi starts low under dialogue
why: tension — introduces the solution and shows real use without overpromising

label: REVEAL
text: Cuma tujuh puluh lima ribu, cek di keranjang kuning ya!
start_state: Creator smiling directly at camera, full product label of Scarlett Acne Serum clearly visible held up near face
framing: medium selfie, face and product hero shot
action: Creator holds product label facing camera, then points finger downward toward keranjang kuning, then winks at lens
audio_note: lo-fi music lifts slightly on CTA
why: payoff — price reveal plus clear action step converts warm viewer into buyer
